[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Aleene''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who was second-in-command of [[Titan Base]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base in the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]].<ref name="OSG" />
